name: Blanket Stitch
description: Squares of colored felt sewn down slightly askew, each edged with a cream blanket stitch: a running thread with short upright stitches at even spacing.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5), var(--color6)); -webkit-transform: rotate(@r(-9, 9)deg) scale(0.8); transform: rotate(@r(-9, 9)deg) scale(0.8); :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @var(--stitches); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --stitches: linear-gradient(var(--color1), var(--color1)) 50% 8.18% / 84% 2.2% no-repeat, linear-gradient(var(--color1), var(--color1)) 50% 91.82% / 84% 2.2% no-repeat, linear-gradient(var(--color1), var(--color1)) 8.18% 50% / 2.2% 84% no-repeat, linear-gradient(var(--color1), var(--color1)) 91.82% 50% / 2.2% 84% no-repeat, repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color1) 0 2.6%, transparent 2.6% 10%) 59.18% 8.99% / 80.4% 11% no-repeat, repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color1) 0 2.6%, transparent 2.6% 10%) 59.18% 91.01% / 80.4% 11% no-repeat, repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, var(--color1) 0 2.6%, transparent 2.6% 10%) 8.99% 59.18% / 11% 80.4% no-repeat, repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, var(--color1) 0 2.6%, transparent 2.6% 10%) 91.01% 59.18% / 11% 80.4% no-repeat; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
